crossRefs.note: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us…
By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his one…
Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.
translations.bsb: Then Abraham reached out his hand and took the knife to slaughter his son.
translations.kjv: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
